children: Hungary posted a current account deficit (HUCAQ=ECI) of €245 million ($278.93 million) in the second quarter of 2026, after a revised surplus of €349 million in the previous quarter, central bank data showed on Friday.
The first quarter figure was revised from a previously reported surplus of €251 million.
